_comment: 复制到 ~/.config/vibegauge/prices.json 后自己填价。单位 = 每百万 token。VibeGauge 不内置价目表：价格随时在变，编一个假的比不显示更糟。全 0 的行视为「没填价」，面板上会显示「该模型不在价目表里」而不是 0.00。模型名按最长前缀命中，所以填 "glm-4.7" 就能覆盖 "glm-4.7-flash"。cache_read / cache_write 省略时按 in 计。
_comment_en: Copy to ~/.config/vibegauge/prices.json and fill in your own prices, per million tokens. VibeGauge ships no built-in price list: prices change constantly and a made-up number is worse than none. All-zero rows count as 'not priced' (the panel says so instead of showing 0.00). Model names match by longest prefix, so "glm-4.7" also covers "glm-4.7-flash". cache_read / cache_write default to 'in' when omitted. Set _currency to USD/CNY/… and _asof to the date you copied the prices.
_asof: 填你抄价那天的日期，面板会显示它，提醒你这数字有多旧
